summary: The exact candidate adds only a relay regression and reports. That regression passes unchanged on the recorded base, while end-to-end overlap NGRAM remains blocked because the pinned loaded kernel egg lacks the CPU and GPU reconstruction operators. This is test-only hardening, not an original-issue fix.

tests.what_was_measured: The candidate's exact four-case relay regression against recorded-base implementation: 4 passed, proving there is no base failure for this test.
The exact candidate at 476b730: 4 passed; behavior is unchanged from base.
Two independent relay edge cases passed: zero/full accepted-row isolation with max-depth truncation, and empty-batch fixed-width behavior.
At base and candidate, direct CPU wrapper execution fails because torch.ops.sgl_kernel.reconstruct_indices_from_tree_mask_cpu is absent.
At base and candidate on the assigned MI355X, direct GPU wrapper execution fails because torch.ops.sgl_kernel.reconstruct_indices_from_tree_mask is absent.
Three adjacent real-GPU speculative KV-index cases passed, including top-k 4/page-size 16 against a Python reference; NGRAM serving was not exercised.

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), ROCm 7.2/Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. The NGRAM reconstruction call reached the loaded wrapper but failed on the missing registered GPU op; adjacent KV-index numerical-reference tests passed.
remaining_counterexamples: The candidate has no implementation/native change and its added relay regression already passes on the recorded base.
End-to-end overlap NGRAM cannot execute because the pinned loaded sglang-kernel 0.4.6.post1 egg lacks reconstruct_indices_from_tree_mask_cpu and reconstruct_indices_from_tree_mask.

Combined top-k/page-size serving, memory over-allocation optimization, optional verify synchronization, penalty support, universal worker parity, high-throughput specialization, EP/DeepEP, PD disaggregation, and a separate plan stream remain unimplemented or unqualified.
No independent EAGLE model-accuracy, attention-backend matrix, distributed DP/EP, PD-disaggregation, or LoRA serving result is provided.
Passing adjacent speculative KV-index tests do not prove the NGRAM serving contract or the full overlap-spec roadmap.
remaining_limitations: The prepared environment supplies one AMD Instinct MI355X only; NVIDIA-specific backends and distributed topologies were unavailable.
No qualified EAGLE/NGRAM model weights were supplied for semantic serving accuracy.
The required interpreter loads sgl_kernel from the pinned 0.4.6.post1 egg rather than repository AOT Python sources; repository-environment.json provides no native artifact or rebuild command.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture can qualify transport/engine execution only and cannot overcome the missing operator or establish another model architecture's semantic accuracy.
